text: Hastings had come to London. <break time="0.8s" /> To sell a mine. <break time="0.8s" /> The Gould and Curry Extension. <break time="0.8s" /> But he had failed. <break time="0.8s" /> And he was nearly ruined. <break time="0.8s" /> I told him that he could use my name freely. <break time="0.8s" /> To sell the mine. <break time="0.8s" /> And that we would share the profit equally. <break time="0.8s" /> When people asked me about the mine. <break time="0.8s" /> I only said. <break time="0.8s" /> I know the man. <break time="0.8s" /> And I know the mine. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon it was sold. <break time="0.8s" /> When the thirty days were over I put on my best clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> And went to the brothers house. <break time="0.8s" /> With Portia. <break time="0.8s" /> I handed back the note. <break time="0.8s" /> And Brother B. <break time="0.8s" /> Who had bet on me. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried, I have won. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I showed them. <break time="0.8s" /> A bank certificate for two hundred thousand pounds. <break time="0.8s" /> My share from the sale of the mine. <break time="0.8s" /> The two old men stared in surprise. <break time="0.8s" /> And then Portia explained that the winner was her stepfather. <break time="0.8s" /> And the other was her uncle. <break time="0.8s" /> When her stepfather asked me. <break time="0.8s" /> Which position I wanted. <break time="0.8s" /> I took Portias hand. <break time="0.8s" /> And answered, Son in law. <break time="0.8s" /> The note became his wedding present to me. <break time="0.8s" /> And it has hung in a frame. <break time="0.8s" /> In the most sacred place in our home. <break time="0.8s" /> Ever since. <break time="0.8s" /> If I had not stopped. <break time="0.8s" /> To stare at that pear. <break time="0.8s" /> On Portland Place. <break time="0.8s" /> I would never have found. <break time="0.8s" /> My fortune or my wife.
